description.fun: Aerodactyl ruled the prehistoric skies with saw-like fangs that could tear through even Steel Pokémon, and it's thought to have died out when a giant meteor struck. It was brought back using genetic material from amber, though there were casualties along the way and the restoration isn't considered perfect. Pterosaurs are called 'winged dragons' in Japanese, which may be why it looks like a wyvern.
description.guide: A grey, pterosaur-like Rock and Flying Fossil Pokémon with large wings and serrated fangs. It is revived from an Old Amber and does not evolve. It is the only Fossil Pokémon that can Mega Evolve.
description.tagline: A prehistoric flyer brought back from amber

description.fun: Mega Evolution reawakens dormant genes, covering Aerodactyl in stony spikes, some harder than diamond, which some scholars believe is how it looked in prehistoric times. The strain makes it so irritable that it attacks anything that moves.
